description: Wisdom has been calling. People have been ignoring her. Verse 31 is the natural consequence. They eat the bitter fruit of living their own way.
excerpt: The very lifestyle that promised to set everyone free is producing a generation that cannot get out of bed without medication. That is not a coincidence. It is the exact fruit Proverbs described thousands of years ago.
verse: "Therefore, they must eat the bitter fruit of living their own way, choking on their own schemes."
body_html:
The context around this verse matters.

The whole chapter is Wisdom personified as a woman standing on the busy corners of the city, crying out to anyone who will listen. She has been calling. She has been reaching out. She has been offering correction. And people have been ignoring her over and over. Verse 31 is the natural consequence of what happens when people keep rejecting wisdom.

They eat the bitter fruit of living their own way.

They choke on their own schemes.

We are watching this play out in real time in our culture. People are living exactly the way they want. They are throwing off anything that resembles boundaries or truth or authority. They are chasing whatever feels right in the moment. They are calling it freedom.

And they are more miserable than ever.

Anxiety is at record highs. Depression is climbing. Loneliness is being called a public health crisis. Relationships are falling apart. People do not know who they are anymore. The very lifestyle that promised to set everyone free is producing a generation that cannot get out of bed without medication.

That is not a coincidence.

It is the exact fruit Proverbs described thousands of years ago. When you reject wisdom and live your own way, you eventually have to eat what you planted. Your own schemes catch up with you. The freedom you thought you were chasing becomes a cage of consequences you did not see coming.

The saddest part is that Wisdom is still calling. She has not gone quiet. God is still offering direction. He is still holding out truth. He is still inviting people back to a way of living that actually leads to life. But you cannot keep rejecting Him and expect a different outcome than the one He has already warned about.

I do not say any of this smugly. I say it grieving.

Because I know people who are living this out. I know families who are watching it happen. I know a whole generation of young people who were told the world had better answers than God, and they are drowning in the fruit of that lie.

The way back is the same as it has always been. Turn around. Listen to Wisdom. Fear the Lord. Take the correction. Choose His way over your own.
question: Where in your life have you been living your own way and starting to taste the bitter fruit of it?
